admission.heading: Before a stream opens
admission.quotedRow: The required signed identity or direct permission was not accepted. Check the selected ChatGPT account and granted scopes.

admission.heading: Before a stream opens
admission.quotedRow: A policy or permission check, such as the permitted serving region, prevented admission. Surface the restriction and verify the integration.

admission.heading: Before a stream opens
admission.quotedRow: Direct routing is unavailable or not enabled. Preserve credentials and use bounded backoff for temporary failures.

structured.heading: Structured Responses errors
structured.quotedRow: ChatGPT plan usage is unavailable for the selected user, workspace, or policy. Explain the restriction; do not repeat the same request or loop through OAuth.

structured.heading: Structured Responses errors
structured.quotedRow: Pause new requests that use the user’s ChatGPT plan and link to ChatGPT settings → Usage. Do not assume the entire plan is empty or infer a reset time from this code alone; an app-specific limit can also apply.

structured.heading: Structured Responses errors
structured.quotedRow: Usage availability could not be checked. Preserve credentials and retry later with bounded backoff.

structured.heading: Structured Responses errors
structured.quotedRow: Inspect error.param and remove the unsupported input, tool, execution feature, model, or service-tier override. Do not retry the same invalid body.

structured.heading: Structured Responses errors
structured.quotedRow: Check the exact HTTP method and endpoint. The examples in Models and inference use POST /v1/responses; support for another client type or route is not permission to use it here.

structured.heading: Structured Responses errors
structured.quotedRow: The subscriber context could not be validated. Preserve the request ID and diagnose the credential failure. Ask the user to sign in again after confirmed revocation or a terminal refresh error.

structured.heading: Structured Responses errors
structured.quotedRow: The signed permission context does not authorize the operation. Check the client and grant configuration rather than retrying or changing billing.

structured.heading: Structured Responses errors
structured.quotedRow: User/workspace information is temporarily unavailable. Preserve credentials and retry with bounded backoff.

refreshErrors.quotedRow: Unusable refresh token: invalid_grant on refresh, invalid_refresh_token, token_expired, refresh_token_expired, refresh_token_invalidated, or refresh_token_reused. Clear unusable tokens and repeat OAuth with the saved issued client ID.

unsupportedFields.quotedRow: Unsupported fields: Omit background, conversation, max_output_tokens, max_tool_calls, metadata, moderation, multi_agent, prompt, prompt_cache_retention, safety_identifier, temperature, top_logprobs, top_p, truncation, and user.
unsupportedFields.previousResponseId: Omit previous_response_id over HTTP and send the required history in input.

unsupportedTools.quotedRow: Unsupported tools: Image generation, file search, Code Interpreter, native computer use, hosted MCP/connectors, and Responses tool_search. Client-side execution does not make tool_search supported. programmatic_tool_calling is not accepted in top-level tools on this route.

requirements.quotedRow: HTTP requests: Set store: false and stream: true. Send input as an array containing the context needed for each request. Use instructions or developer messages; explicit {type: "message", role: "system"} items are rejected.

unsupportedInputs.quotedRow: Inputs: Text, images, and files are supported when the selected model accepts them. Audio/video input, the Files upload API, and the transcription API are not supported by this flow.
